    actionPerformed(ActionEvent e)
    handles an action being performed if the button clicked is a space, updates the fields accordingly - if clicking on a new piece, selects that piece - if clicking on an already selected piece, deselects the piece - if clicking on a legal move of the selected piece, makes the move - if clicking on another space that is not any of the above, deselects selected piece if the button clicked is a promotion button, finishes the promotion based on the button clicked

    • promote

      public void promote(Piece promotingPiece, int color, String promotingText, String promote, boolean captured)
      Parameters:

      color - - color of the promoting piece
      promotingText - - string that is the beginning of the notation of the promotion (will be added to)

      captured - - whether or not a piece was captured during the promotion automatically promotes the pawn to a piece based on the promote string

    • checkGameEnd

      public boolean checkGameEnd(int movingColor, boolean checking)
      Parameters:
      movingColor - - which color is going to move
      checking - - whether or not a king is in check
      Returns:
      whether or not the game ended checks if the game ended and updates Coordinator.winner accordingly checks each piece's legal moves to see if a move is possible -1 = draw, 0 = white win, 1 = black win

    • discoveredCheck

      public boolean discoveredCheck(Piece movingPiece, int newR, int newC)
      Parameters:
      movingPiece - - piece to move
      newR - - row to move to
      newC - - column to move to
      Returns:
      whether or not a discovered check occurred from moving the piece checks if a discovered check (other piece checks from moving out of the way) occurred creates a temporary board that has the new position after the piece has been moved and then checks if that places other king in check

    • checkChecks

      public boolean checkChecks(Piece movingPiece, int newR, int newC)
      Parameters:
      movingPiece - - piece that is moving
      newR - - row to move to
      newC - - column to move to
      Returns:
      whether or not a piece moving places their king in check checks if moving a piece will put their king in check includes checking if a king is castling through check creates a temporary board with the new position after the move then checks all of the other color's pieces to see if they are checking the king

    • loadGame

      public void loadGame(File file)
      Parameters:
      file - - file to read from loads a game from a text file resets board first then reads line by line for each move and automatically plays the moves threads used to show the moves being played one by one in quick succession

    • loadGameState

      public void loadGameState(Scanner scanner, boolean send)
      Parameters:
      scanner - - scanner of either the file/string to be read
      send - - whether or not to send the message to the other client (prevents infinite loops) loads a game state (a board position not based on moves that led up to the position) from either a file or a string includes checks to make sure that the game state is possible - has 2 kings - has a possible number of pawns - has a possible number of pieces - pawn, rook, and king conditions match where there are on the board then starts play from this game state
